v2.note: Haiku 5.5, one question as last sentence, always quote, no menus of options

v3.note: v2 plus: never help with off-topic requests, no explaining rules, stuck step without examples

v4.note: v3 plus: nothing after the question, stuck step phrased as a question, no either/or questions

v5.note: v3 safety rules kept; quote only their own idea, never requests or meta text, declines in six words at most, 1 or 2 short sentences, question anchored in the draft or mission

v6.note: v5 plus: the distress pause uses the exact phrase the app recognises (and coach.mts recognises more Italian pause wordings)

v7.note: v6 plus: one question only (no 'and' joining two), no extra instruction, open with the question unless they asked for the answer (in production on 2026-10-09 until v7d added the German and French line)

v7d.note: IN PRODUCTION since 2026-10-09 deploy 6ac8f3ac: v7 plus the German and French language line (app language always)
